key_impacts: Fishermen lost most of their fishing boats.
Parts of the mangrove forests remained underwater.
Properties in low-lying coastal areas were destroyed.
Few lives were lost due to timely coast guard warnings.
missing_information: Exact casualty and damage figures missing

key_impacts: People lost most of their animals due to lack of drinking water.
Electricity was unavailable for industries and homes.
Industries were forced to close, and many people lost their jobs.
The community mainly survived on food relief from government and well-wishers.
missing_information: Exact settlement name within Amu Island not specified
